titulo: How to tell someone you miss them: 4 texts
caption:
How to tell someone you miss them: four short texts you can copy.
Send one today.
Link in bio.
by NMR

alt.1: Cella looking at a big phone. Send · 4 texts to say I miss you. How to tell someone you miss them (without checking their story first). 4 short texts. Send one today.
alt.2: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. After a long silence. I was thinking about you. No reason. Just hi. When it has been months. Why it works: no pressure, no agenda.
alt.3: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. After a fight. I've been thinking about what I said. I was wrong. Annoying, I know. When you were wrong. Why it works: you said it first.
alt.4: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. Far away. I miss you. Can I call you Sunday? When time zones win. Why it works: a day beats “soon.”
alt.5: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. Lost touch. No need to reply. I just wanted you to know I remember you. When you're nervous. Why it works: it takes the pressure off.
alt.6: the four texts as a list. The cheat sheet. Saying I miss you: Cella has sent all four. Twice. Zero replies. Thriving. 1. Just hi. No reason. 2. I was wrong. No “but.” 3. Can I call Sunday? 4. No need to reply.
